name: 24 Port + 4 SFP  POE Switch.xlsx
text:
--- Sheet: Sheet1 ---
	24-port 10/100/1000Base-T with 4 × 1G/2.5G/10G SFP ports POE Switch
	Fixed ports	24*10/100/1000M RJ45 ports,4*1G/2.5G/10G SFP+ slots
	Switching capacity	128Gbps
	Packet forwarding rate	95Mpps
	Console port	1
	Flash	512M
	RAM	512M
	MAC address table	16K
	Jumbo Frame	10K
	Buffer Size	12M bit
	Total output BTU (1000BTU/H=293W)	1445.84
	Noise@25°C(dBA)	<35db
	MTBF(H)	＞200,000
	FAN	Fan speed control
	Dimension (WxDxH)mm
	Weight (KG)	3.3 -5kg
	Power Supply	220V AC input Rated voltage range:100-240V Frequency：50/60Hz / 48V DC
	Power Consumption No-Load	≤30W
	Power Consumption Full-Load	≤430W
	POE Power Budget	≤400W
	POE (IEEE802.3af)/POE+ (IEEE802.3at)	Support
	Operating & Storage temperature	0  ~50  & -20  ~75
	Working & Storage relative humidity	10%~90% & 5%~95%
	Forwarding mode	Store-forward
	Port aggregation	10GE port aggregation
2.5GE aggregation GE aggregation
Static aggregation Dynamic aggregation
	Port features	IEEE802.3x flow control Interface counters Port isolation Storm control
Network storm suppression based on port bandwidth
	Mac-address table management	Static Mac-address management Dynamic Mac-address Management Filtering Mac-address,MAC limit based on port & VLAN MAC flapping based on port & VLAN
	VLAN	4K, Access, trunk and hybrid mode
	VLAN Classification	Mac Based VLAN IP Based VLAN,Protocol Based VLAN
	GVRP	Normal mode,Fixed mode Forbidden mode
	QinQ	Port-based QinQ VLAN-based QinQ, Flow-based QinQ
	LLDP	LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol)
	DHCP	DHCP Server DHCP client DHCP snooping trust port
Remote-id/circuit-id configuration DHCP option-82
	ACL	IP Standard ACL MAC extend ACL
IP extend ACL IPv6 ACL
	QoS	QoS Class, remarking
SP, WRR queue scheduling
Ingress port-based rate-limit Egress port-based rate-limit
	Security	Port Security, Dot1x, port authentication, MAC authentication, RADIUS, TACACS, ARP Source Guard, IP Port/MAC  binding, ARP-check  and ARP  packet  filtering  for illegal users
	Centralised Cloud	Cloud Management System
	Management and maintenance	User management and login authentication Console Telnet SSH
Web management, HTTP, HTTPS SNMPV1/V2C/V3 Syslog and alarm grading RMON
NTP
Sflow
Temperature monitoring Ping, Tracert Cable detection Dying gasp DDM TFTP
Dual partition management
